equations: i=(1+j/m)^(m/p)-1 for nominal annual j compounded m times, paid p times
periodic-rate.notes: Use expm1/log1p for stability. j decimals, m/p positive. APY is effective annual, not nominalAPR.

amortization.notes: Reduce last payment to actual balance+interest; stop negative amortization explicitly; amortization may round interest each period or only display, but disclose and use one convention.

tvm.notes: Signs represent cash in/out. Solve one unknown. RATE/IRR roots may be absent or nonunique; bracket and scan, never return arbitrary unconverged Newton estimate.

growth.notes: Different monthly/annual additions, tax timing, contribution growth and fees require period simulation. Do not treat tax on earnings as tax on all balances.

equations: XIRR solves sum(CF_j/(1+r)^((date_j-date_0)/365))=0 with explicitACT/365 convention
discounting.notes: Irregular amount cash flows are not necessarily irregular date cash flows. Competitor IRR second mode is annual amounts; Average Return first mode has actual dates.

equations: Capital gains stack above ordinary taxable income before applying0/15/20 bands
tax.notes: Apply correct year/status and deductions before bands; credits afterwards per eligibility. Version full legal rules separately.

bmi.notes: Classify unrounded BMI; adultCDC20+, child2-19 uses age/sex LMS data. No diagnostic labels.

energy.notes: Wkg,Hcm,Ayears,kcal/day. Activity factors are heuristic and must be displayed; Katch exact primary provenance remains to verify. These models are not for automated prescribing.

pregnancy-date.notes: Use calendar-day arithmetic independent ofDST. Cycle adjustment is a calendar estimate; first-trimester dating/clinician decisions supersede it. Do not infer exact paternity/conception.
